errors.evidence: The reference shows Std: 0.0 = 49.0%, Std: 0.47 = 38.0%, Std: 0.82 = 5.0%, Std: 0.94 = 7.0%. The machine description has incorrectly mapped the percentages to the categories.
The reference shows Max: 1 = 47.7%, Max: 2 = 39.0%, Max: 3 = 14.2%. The machine description has incorrectly mapped the percentages to the inner ring categories.
The reference describes the inner ring colors as medium blue, light blue, and very light blue (shades of blue), not teal colors.
There are 4 outer ring slices + 3 inner ring slices = 7 slices total, not nine.
The reference mentions that legends are included separately for each ring, but the machine description only mentions a single legend without specifying it is organized per ring.
